description: READ-ONLY: verify the four oldest in-app database dumps (records, size, recomputed sha256, references). Changes nothing.

runCommand: echo '== 1. backup records for the four dumps (read-only query) =='

docker exec shared_postgres psql -U postgres -d erpx -tA -F ' | ' -c "select id, status, started_at, size_bytes, sha256, storage_key from backup_jobs where id::text in ('60b5ddc6-ab6d-4dcb-a36b-9085908d5589','6d502c1b-d465-4690-848e-6b161f0099a1','6b693aff-1ca9-4d19-851d-1e585c63b0de','aec2d1b7-6673-4674-86c9-1832afe0db6b') order by started_at"
echo '== 2. the newest two backup records, which must be kept =='
docker exec shared_postgres psql -U postgres -d erpx -tA -F ' | ' -c "select id, status, started_at, size_bytes, storage_key from backup_jobs order by started_at desc limit 2"
echo '== 3. size and recomputed sha256 of each object, read through MinIO (not modified) =='

printf 'import hashlib,sys
from minio import Minio
from app.core.config import settings as s
c=Minio(s.MINIO_ENDPOINT,access_key=s.MINIO_ACCESS_KEY,secret_key=s.MINIO_SECRET_KEY,secure=s.MINIO_SECURE)
for key in sys.argv[1:]:
    st=c.stat_object(s.MINIO_BUCKET,key); h=hashlib.sha256(); r=c.get_object(s.MINIO_BUCKET,key)
    for chunk in r.stream(1048576): h.update(chunk)
    r.close(); r.release_conn(); print(key,st.size,h.hexdigest())
' > /tmp/ro_hash.py

KEYS=$(docker exec shared_postgres psql -U postgres -d erpx -tA -c "select storage_key from backup_jobs where id::text in ('60b5ddc6-ab6d-4dcb-a36b-9085908d5589','6d502c1b-d465-4690-848e-6b161f0099a1','6b693aff-1ca9-4d19-851d-1e585c63b0de','aec2d1b7-6673-4674-86c9-1832afe0db6b') order by started_at")
nice -n 19 ionice -c3 docker exec -i erpx_api python - $KEYS < /tmp/ro_hash.py; rm -f /tmp/ro_hash.py
echo '== 4. is anything on the host or in the repo config pointing at these files? =='
echo '== 5. space that deleting them would free =='

docker exec shared_postgres psql -U postgres -d erpx -tA -c "select pg_size_pretty(sum(size_bytes)) from backup_jobs where id::text in ('60b5ddc6-ab6d-4dcb-a36b-9085908d5589','6d502c1b-d465-4690-848e-6b161f0099a1','6b693aff-1ca9-4d19-851d-1e585c63b0de','aec2d1b7-6673-4674-86c9-1832afe0db6b')"
